name: Amumu
title: the Sad Mummy

Q.name: Bandage Toss
Q.description: Amumu launches a bandage, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, Stunning them for 1 second, and dealing 70/95/120/145/170 + 0.85×AP magic damage. This Ability has 2 charges.
Q.summary: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

W.name: Despair
W.description: Toggle: Amumu begins crying, dealing 10 plus 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + 0.005×AP% max Health magic damage to nearby enemies every second and refreshing Curse.
W.summary: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

E.name: Tantrum
E.description: Passive: Amumu takes 5/7/9/11/13 + 0.03×bonus armor + 0.03×bonus MR reduced physical damage. Additionally, when Amumu is hit by an Attack, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds. Active: Amumu throws a tantrum, dealing 65/95/125/155/185 + 0.5×AP magic damage to nearby enemies.
E.summary: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

R.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
R.description: Amumu flares out his bandages, Stunning for 1.5 seconds, dealing 200/300/400 + 0.8×AP magic damage and applying Curse.
R.summary: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

Passive.name: Cursed Touch
Passive.description: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.
Passive.summary: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tank jungler who dashes in with Q bandage stuns and stuns everyone around him with R. Wins teamfights with a big area stun followed by W/E area damage and Curse true damage.
strengths: R area stun: game-winning engage in teamfights
Q has 2 charges: two bandage dashes and stuns
Curse passive makes magic damage deal bonus true damage
E passive reduces physical damage taken; cooldown drops when he is attacked
Strong area damage with W aura + E
weaknesses: Q is a skillshot: missed bandages leave him with no engage
Kited if both Q charges are missed

curve.items: strong – Sunfire/Hollow Radiance and Liandry's Torment

profile.curveNote: R is his real power spike; earlier ganks rely on Q landing.

Passive.notes: Attacks Curse: cursed targets take bonus true damage from magic damage.

Q.notes: Bandage: pulls him to first enemy hit, stuns. 2 charges.

W.notes: Toggle aura: max-health damage; refreshes Curse.

E.notes: Area damage; passive physical damage reduction.

profile.windowAgainst: R down, or both Q charges spent/missed: he can't engage.
